mode.title: Training or PPE?
mode.trainingHint: Each person signs with badge and PIN; the trainer countersigns
mode.ppeHint: Items handed to a person, who signs the receipt with their PIN
mode.offline: Signing needs the network: each PIN is checked by the office at once and never kept on this tablet.
mode.paper: Signed here instead of on paper: each person signs with their own PIN, and the office keeps the register.

sessions.title: Training attendance
sessions.empty: No training session is open at this site
sessions.emptyHint: The trainer opens the session in the office (People › Skills & training); it shows here at once.
sessions.hint: Pick the session you are attending.

keys.open: Open the session with the focus

session.scanHint: Then type your PIN. The office checks it at once; it is never kept on this tablet.

who.unknown: This badge is not known here, or the person no longer works here. Ask your team leader.
who.noRoster: This tablet has no list of names: scan the badge.

stopped.title: Signing has stopped
stopped.closed: This session was closed in the office: nobody signs it any more.
stopped.cancelled: This session was cancelled in the office: nobody signs it any more.
stopped.cancelledWhy: This session was cancelled in the office: {reason}

done.signed: {name} signed at {time}. Next person: scan your badge.

trainer.title: The trainer: {name}
trainer.hint: When everyone has signed, the trainer checks each person's language and countersigns with their own PIN.
trainer.outside: {name} has no sign-in at this site: the office countersigns from the paper sheet.

pin.wrong: The badge or PIN is wrong, or this person is locked for a few minutes after too many wrong PINs.
pin.rateLimited: Too many tries on this tablet: wait a moment, then try again.
pin.offline: No network: signing waits for it. Nothing was signed.
pin.unavailable: The office did not answer. Try again: nothing is signed twice.

check.title: Did each person understand the session in {language}?
check.law: The trainer checks that each person understood the language the session was held in (D.Lgs. 81/2008 art. 37 c.13). Answer for each person.
check.notUnderstoodMeans: Someone who did not understand does not pass this training: it is repeated in a language they understand.

countersign.title: Countersign as the trainer
countersign.summary_other: You countersign the attendance of {count} people.

ppe.title: Receive PPE
ppe.law: The person who receives signs the receipt with their own PIN (D.Lgs. 81/2008 art. 77 c.4).
ppe.scan: Scan the badge of the person who receives
ppe.scanHint: Their kit's missing items come up by themselves.

person.noRole: No role sheet: nothing is prefilled.

lines.title: To hand over
lines.empty: Nothing yet: pick an item below or scan its code.

add.title: Add an item
add.scanHint: Scan the item's code, or pick its tile.
add.unknown: No item with the code {code} here: pick its tile.
add.none: This company has no PPE items yet: the office adds them to the PPE catalogue.

line.oneSize: One size: no size to pick.
line.sizeHint: Pick the size: it adds the item.
line.unknownItem: An item no longer in the catalogue

receipt.title: Sign the receipt
receipt.office: The office sees the receipt at once, with the items and how it was signed.

held.offline: Needs the network: a signature is checked by the office at once

countersign.outsideTrainer: The trainer has no sign-in here: the office countersigns
countersign.nobody: Nobody waits for the trainer's countersignature

receive.size: An item still needs its size
receive.tooMany: At most 20 items on one receipt

SESSION_STOPPED.message: This session was closed or cancelled in the office: signing has stopped.
SESSION_STOPPED.fix: Ask the trainer which session is open now.

ATTENDED_ALREADY.fix: Nothing more to do: the next person scans their badge.

PERSON_NOT_ACTIVE.message: This person no longer works for the company.
PERSON_NOT_ACTIVE.fix: Ask the office to check the person's record.

PERSON_OTHER_COMPANY.message: This person works for another company than the session's.
PERSON_OTHER_COMPANY.fix: Ask the trainer: they sign a session of their own company.

NO_EMPLOYEE.message: This sign-in is not linked to a person's record yet.
NO_EMPLOYEE.fix: Ask the office to link it first; meanwhile sign on paper.

NOT_THE_TRAINER.message: Only the session's trainer countersigns, with their own PIN.

NO_TRAINER_WORKER.message: The trainer has no sign-in at this site.
NO_TRAINER_WORKER.fix: The office countersigns from the paper sheet.

COUNTERSIGNED_ALREADY.fix: The list was read again: check it and countersign once more.

ATTENDANCE_VOIDED.message: The office voided an attendance meanwhile.
ATTENDANCE_VOIDED.fix: The list was read again: check it and countersign once more.

NOT_OF_SESSION.message: An attendance is not of this session.
NOT_OF_SESSION.fix: The list was read again: check it and countersign once more.

NOT_ACTIVE.message: This person no longer works here: PPE is handed only to people who work for the company.
NOT_ACTIVE.fix: Ask the office to check the person's record.

OTHER_COMPANY.message: This person works for another company than this site's.
OTHER_COMPANY.fix: PPE is handed over at a site of their own company.
